requirements.text: Finished-seam handoff rule (standing): a PLANNED session handoff may be written only at a truly finished seam. Before the handoff, the outgoing session must complete the seam entirely: (a) the D-069 backlog sweep recorded; (b) the NEXT task packet fully contracted - packet body written and checked, directive refs bound with applicable == cited, new-file placeholders seeded, G0 recorded at the contract head, task claimed with progress logged, all committed and pushed; (c) the task worktree created at the contract head; (d) the loop launcher ACTIVE-TASK block updated to that packet with a fresh run-id. The successor startup then reduces to: verify state, revoke stale approvals, launch the loop, re-arm the watcher.
requirements.required_harness: Every subsequent planned handoff shows the seam already done (next packet contracted/claimed/pushed + launcher pointed) before the handoff commit.
requirements.required_evidence: the handoff commit history: contract-seam commits precede the handoff commit
requirements.status_reason: Captured; binds every future planned handoff.

requirements.text: The standing rule is recorded IN docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md as a permanent preamble item that survives every handoff rewrite (owner: "add it in seasen handoff"), so each outgoing session sees the finished-seam requirement in the very document it is about to write.
requirements.required_harness: Preamble block present in docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md; retained across subsequent handoff rewrites.

requirements.text: Fallback exception (owner-accepted): when a session ends WITHOUT the prepared seam (crash, machine sleep, forced shutdown, account exhaustion, or any unplanned turnover), the successor performs the full seam itself - sweep, contract, relaunch, watcher - as the fallback path. The exception never becomes the norm: a session that CAN finish the seam before handing off must.
requirements.required_harness: Unplanned-turnover successors may run the seam without treating R001 as violated; the handoff/blocker record names the unplanned cause.
requirements.required_evidence: successor session records naming the unplanned cause when the fallback is used
